note: LR 1.2e-3 = 2x the inherited 6e-4. Zero throughput cost, so any gain is pure iso-compute gain -- which the arm-10 reframe says is where the value now is. 6e-4 was tuned for a 1.04B model at a ~524k batch; this is 2.06B at 245,760. The 450-step arch sweep preferred 1.6e-3 for a 1B at 131k batch, so the inherited value may well be low here.
